findings.attack_strategy: GET request with auto_dispatch parameter reflecting in HTML body. Use script payload like '<script>alert(\"XSS\")</script>' to execute JavaScript in the page context.
findings.rationale: Unique endpoint with auto_dispatch parameter in HTML body context. No framework sandboxing detected, making script payloads effective.
